messages:
alyssa: FYI canary promotion stalled, CI hitting impersonation timeouts against the service account — helm apply step keeps failing.
ben: seeing same. job ci/canary-deploy-3 timed out at 'auth:impersonate-sa' step, logs show rpc error: DeadlineExceeded when fetching token.
ci-bot: Job ci/canary-deploy-3 failed — step 'auth:impersonate-sa' exit 1
marta: is this the rotation window? we rotated SA keys at 03:00 UTC earlier.
alyssa: not a key rotation. iamcredentials API is returning 429 rateLimitExceeded for impersonation: "Request throttled".
tim: pasted error snippet:
```
rpc error: code = ResourceExhausted desc = quota exceeded for service iamcredentials.googleapis.com
```
ben: i can repro locally — `gcloud auth print-identity-token --impersonate-service-account=svc-deployer@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com` starts failing after ~60 requests/min.
alyssa: context: our canary rollout spins up 8 parallel job pods, each requests a short-lived token per pod start. that creates a spike of iamcredentials calls at the same second.
marta: short-term mitigation options?
ben: quick fix: reduce parallelism to 1 for the canary and re-run. that'll reduce spike but slows rollout.
tim: risk callout: single-rep canary reduces signal and lengthens promotion time. ok for infra-only changes, but call it out in release notes.
alyssa: proposal: open infra PR to set `maxParallelism: 1` for canary overlay + add ephemeral token caching (reuse token for 10m per runner) as hotfix. manual promote after green.
ben: filing GCP support ticket for quota bump: https://console.cloud.google.com/support/issue/GA1234567890 — ticket created.
ci-bot: PR #789 opened by alyssa: `infra/canary/patch: set maxParallelism=1 and add token cache` — https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/789
marta: can we add fallback to node-level SA if impersonation fails? lower priority but useful.
alyssa: noted, will add as follow-up backlog item.
ben: re-running pipeline now with pinned parallelism.
ci-bot: Job ci/canary-deploy-3 re-run started — https://ci.redwood.dev/builds/555
ben: logs look green, token reuse landed in the agent init step.
tim: coordinating manual promote window at 20:30 UTC (oncall standby)
deploy-bot: manual promotion executed by tim at 3243210360
alyssa: manual promote completed successfully :thumbsup:
marta: adding release note: "Mitigated GCP Service Account impersonation quota by reducing canary parallelism and enabling short-lived token caching; follow-up: request quota increase and fallback to node SA."
ben: closing this thread and tracking follow-ups in infra epic."
